cp32:1.1: Punāparaṃ yadā homi Sutasomo mahīpati gahito porisādena brāhmaṇe saṅgaraṃ sariṃ. || ||
cp32:2.1: Khattiyānaṃ ekasataṃ āvunitvā karatale ete sampamilapetvā yañña 'tthe upanayi mamaṃ. || ||
cp32:3.1: Apucchi maṃ porisādo: kiṃ tvaṃ icchasi nissajaṃ yathāmati te kāhāmi yadi me tvaṃ pun' ehisi. || ||
cp32:4.1: Tassa paṭisuṇitvāna paṇhe āgamanaṃ mama upagantvā puraṃ rammaṃ rajjaṃ niyyādayiṃ tadā. || ||
cp32:5.1: Anussaritvā sataṃ dhammaṃ pubbakaṃ jinasevitaṃ brāhmaṇassa dhanaṃ datvā porisādaṃ upāgamiṃ. || ||
cp32:6.1: Natthi me saṃsayo tattha ghātayissati vā na vā saccavācānurakkhanto jīvitaṃ cajitum-upāgamī; saccena me samo natthi esā me saccapāramīti. || ||
